description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging nodes that can output log data and pass it along a chain of log handlers within an Android application.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system component that can output log messages and pass them along to the next node in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable. It directs the log data to the current node's output and forwards it to the next node.
